utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Fontana' by name among the cities in its service area.

generation_supplier.notes: A City of Fontana bid solicitation references a completed CCA feasibility study and an active search for a partner to help launch or join a CCA program, indicating no operational CCA program exists for Fontana yet. Left null rather than asserting a program that is still in a pre-launch/exploratory stage.

county.notes: Fontana is a well-documented San Bernardino County city; also listed under San Bernardino County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.value: City of Fontana Building and Safety Division

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Fontana/San Bernardino County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value: One Building Inspection (899 Permit Final) is required

value.program_or_pathway: SolarAPP+ (Residential Solar PV, with or without Energy Storage)
other_conditions: Only licensed contractors may submit applications through SolarAPP+
Building Integrated Solar PV is explicitly not supported through this portal

value.name: SolarAPP+ processing fee
value.notes: Charged by SolarAPP+ itself. Additional city permit fees are also due when submitting through the BUILD FONTANA portal, but no specific city fee amount was stated on the page.
